title: UU HPP: PPN rate 10% to 11% on 1 April 2022
summary: UU No. 7 Tahun 2021 replaced the 10% PPN rate with 11% from 1 April 2022. Exports stayed at 0%. The later 12% step was scheduled by the same article and is a separate diff.

legal_basis.title: UU PPN konsolidasi dengan tanda perubahan UU HPP
legal_basis.instrument: UU No. 7 Tahun 2021, Pasal 7 ayat (1) huruf a UU PPN

legal_basis.title: Penyesuaian Tarif PPN
legal_basis.instrument: Penjelasan DJP tentang kenaikan dari 10% menjadi 11%

changes.summary: Standard PPN, including self-assessed use of offshore intangible goods and services, moves from 10% to 11%. The export rate stays 0%.

computation.notes: Ordinary DPP. The 11/12 nilai lain mechanism does not exist yet.

migration_impact.summary: Invoices for supplies from 1 April 2022 use 11%. Invoices for supplies through 31 March 2022 stay at 10%. A replacement invoice, or a return or cancellation note, keeps the rate of the original tax invoice even when the replacement is issued on or after 1 April 2022. Do not change the 0% export treatment.
